'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Brian Herold LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)]]
* '''Username:''' AirDog 2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
